nodes.label: publish-codex-package job
nodes.rationale: Only version tags publish; npm publish --provenance with id-token write.

nodes.label: Stdlib-only require() assertion
nodes.rationale: Hook runs inside someone else's session, so must not pull deps at install time; node:-prefixed modules allowed by prefix because an explicit list went stale and failed CI.

nodes.label: Codex CLI support
nodes.rationale: Codex has no plugin marketplace, so hooks are entries in ~/.codex/hooks.json; copies to ~/.pravex/codex because plugin dir changes on update.

nodes.label: Report spool (~/.pravex/spool, max 50)
nodes.rationale: Network/5xx failures replayed next session; 4xx never retried.

nodes.label: Session report payload (metrics only)
nodes.rationale: No prompts, code or file contents; titles masked for key-shaped strings.

nodes.label: Pravex status line indicator
nodes.rationale: Plugins cannot declare statusLine, so it writes ~/.claude/settings.json and copies script to ~/.pravex since plugin dir changes on update.

nodes.label: Background update check
nodes.rationale: Claude Code does not auto-update third-party marketplaces; check at most twice a day, never self-updates.

nodes.label: /pravex:codex command
nodes.rationale: Never interpolate $ARGUMENTS into shell; choose among three fixed commands.

nodes.label: Detached child for SessionEnd (3s cap)
nodes.rationale: Codex caps SessionEnd at three seconds, so the hook hands off to a detached child and returns.

nodes.label: Extracted transcript (tool names only, redacted, gzip, 1MB cap)
nodes.norm_label: extracted transcript (tool names only, redacted, gzip, 1mb cap)
nodes.rationale: Attachments are 79.9% of bytes; keeping prompts/prose/tool names is 0.076% of raw; redact before truncate; drop from front.

nodes.label: filesTouched undercounts on purpose
nodes.rationale: Inventing a file never written is worse than missing script-written files.

nodes.label: SessionStart sweep for unreported sessions
nodes.rationale: SessionEnd doesn't fire when terminal is closed; spool only replays failed POSTs. Sweep bounded by count and age.

nodes.label: Active duration (gaps > 5 min dropped)
nodes.rationale: One overnight session measured 7,237 wall-clock minutes vs ~110 active.

nodes.label: OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628)
nodes.rationale: Pasted keys leak into clipboard, scrollback and the uploaded transcript; one real key was burned that way.

nodes.label: prUrl must belong to session repo
nodes.norm_label: prurl must belong to session repo
nodes.rationale: An unrelated org's PR once appeared in tool output and was misreported.

nodes.label: No dependencies by design
nodes.rationale: Runs inside someone else's Claude Code session; must not pull anything at install time.

nodes.label: Codex token semantics
nodes.rationale: cached_input_tokens subset of input_tokens; reasoning inside output; no cache-write; dedupe token_usage_record on response_id.
